Welcome to the National Year 2000 (Y2K) Clearinghouse. This website is a combination of the President's Council on Year 2000 Conversion, the Chief Information Officer's Council Committee on Year 2000, and the U.S. Federal Gateway for Year 2000 Information Directories.

This clearinghouse creates a single repository of Y2K information to assist the public, business, academia, Federal, state and local governments in obtaining various Y2K information.


This web site is a clearinghouse for information on the Year 2000 computer problem. It is maintained by the U.S. General Services Administration Office of Governmentwide Policy. Inclusion of links to other web sites does not imply endorsement of contents by GSA. Send web master questions or concerns to Mike Johnson at mike.johnson@gsa.gov.
